home.landingIntro: Pippinway is a classified marketplace. People post their own ads for cars, property, electronics, jobs, services and more. Choosing a country opens that local marketplace so you can browse listings posted there.
home.step1Body: Open the market where you want to buy or sell so listings match that country.
home.step2Body: Use search, categories and location to find cars, property, electronics, jobs and more.
home.step3Body: Read the ad, then use Pippinway chat or the WhatsApp number the seller shared.
home.step4Body: Inspect the item before you pay, meet in public where you can, and never share OTPs.
home.shopByLocationBody: Each country page shows listings for that market. Zimbabwe opens Zimbabwe ads, Sri Lanka opens Sri Lankan ads, and so on. You can change country later from the marketplace.

home.seoAboutBody: Pippinway is a classified marketplace. Independent people post ads for cars, motorbikes, property, electronics, fashion, jobs, services and more. Pippinway provides the listing pages, search, chat and account tools. It does not own most of the items shown and does not guarantee that a private sale will complete.
home.seoBuySellBody: This page shows live ads posted for {{market}}. Open a listing for the seller’s photos, price and location, then contact them through Pippinway chat or WhatsApp. Use Change Country if you want another market.
home.seoStep1Body: Use Latest Ads, categories and keywords to find something you want in this country.
home.seoStep2Body: Open the ad. Read the description, photos, price, location and the name on the seller card.
home.seoStep3Body: Use Pippinway chat or the WhatsApp number the seller chose to share on that listing.
home.seoStep4Body: Inspect the item before you pay, meet in public where you can, and never share OTPs or banking passwords.
home.seoSafetyBodyBefore: Listings are user-generated. Compare similar ads, inspect goods in person when you can, and treat advance-payment requests with caution. Pippinway is not an escrow service. Read the
home.seoFeaturedNote: Featured Credits highlight a live ad; Rewards come from eligible listing activity, not from viewing or clicking advertisements.
